library.description: A young-adult cooper (barrel maker) in a newsboy cap, cream shirt with rolled sleeves, brown leather bib apron with brass buttons, dark trousers and boots. Round pale face, dark curly hair, simple dot eyes and thick brows.
library.personality: friendly, curious, hands-on; explains by doing
library.historicalContext: Mid-19th-century cooperage worker (the approved design brief says 1850s). Note: the eight-panel newsboy cap is most typical of the 1880s-1920s; the approved design treats it as period-plausible, so stories set well before 1850 should consider an outfit variant.
library.build: compact, average height (1.40 m in scene scale)
